name: @subset.dev/link-capture
description: Browser-extension link capture: reads the current tab or a link and hands it to a pluggable save target.

scripts.check: npm run build --workspace=@subset.dev/links && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.view.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@subset.dev/links && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config extension/vite.config.ts && node scripts/check-extension-build.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@subset.dev/links && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test test/*.test.mjs
